# Grammar edges, malformed lines, rarely used 5.5.1 forms and GEDCOM 7.1.
#
# Format: `### ID | C|L | purpose (origin)`, then the GEDCOM input, then directives:
#   #want LINE    the written output contains this line
#   #model TEXT   the parsed model keeps this text (newline written \n)
#   #lacks TEXT   the written output does not contain this text
#   #target VERS  write as 5.5.1, 7.0 or 7.1 instead of the input's version
# Tokens: <CR> / <CRLF> end a line with that terminator, <NOEOL> ends the input without one,
# <TAB>, <BOM> and <U+XXXX> stand for those characters. Every name, place and value is fictitious.

### G5-NETWORK-PTR | C | 5.5.1 network pointer forms (`:` reserved for permanent record files, p.16 and p.57; `!` in the same non_at pointer grammar) are pointers, kept verbatim and never resolved locally
0 HEAD
1 SOUR EXAMPLE_APP
1 SUBM @U0@
1 GEDC
2 VERS 5.5.1
2 FORM LINEAGE-LINKED
1 CHAR UTF-8
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NAME Ann /Example/
1 SOUR @ARCHIVE:S77@
1 ASSO @REMOTE!I9@
2 RELA Godparent
0 @U0@ SUBM
1 NAME Example Submitter
0 TRLR
#want 1 SOUR @ARCHIVE:S77@
#want 1 ASSO @REMOTE!I9@

### G5-ESCAPE-NONDATE | C | 5.5.1 escape sequence other than a date calendar (`@#…@ `, p.12 and p.17) in text: kept, and not doubled on write
0 HEAD
1 SOUR EXAMPLE_APP
1 SUBM @U0@
1 GEDC
2 VERS 5.5.1
2 FORM LINEAGE-LINKED
1 CHAR UTF-8
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NAME Ann /Example/
1 NOTE Before @#XFORM@ after, and mail@@example.com
0 @U0@ SUBM
1 NAME Example Submitter
0 TRLR
#want 1 NOTE Before @#XFORM@ after, and mail@@example.com

### G5-SOUR-TEXT-CITATION | C | 5.5.1 citation without a source record: description, TEXT and CONT (SOURCE_CITATION second form)
0 HEAD
1 SOUR EXAMPLE_APP
1 SUBM @U0@
1 GEDC
2 VERS 5.5.1
2 FORM LINEAGE-LINKED
1 CHAR UTF-8
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NAME Ann /Example/
1 BIRT
2 SOUR Parish register of Sampleton
3 CONT volume two
3 TEXT Born on a Sunday
4 CONT at home
0 @U0@ SUBM
1 NAME Example Submitter
0 TRLR
#want 2 SOUR Parish register of Sampleton
#want 3 TEXT Born on a Sunday

### G5-SEX-LOWER | L | lower-case or unknown SEX values (gedcom-go sex-value-variants intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 5.5.1
2 FORM LINEAGE-LINKED
1 CHAR UTF-8
0 @I1@ INDI
1 SEX m
0 @I2@ INDI
1 SEX X
0 TRLR
#model "m"
#model "X"

### G5-XREF-INVALID | L | xrefs not valid in 5.5.1 (leading #, 30 characters): read, written valid
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 5.5.1
2 FORM LINEAGE-LINKED
1 CHAR UTF-8
0 @#I1@ INDI
1 NAME Ann /Example/
0 @IABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123@ INDI
1 NAME Bea /Example/
1 FAMS @F1@
0 @F1@ FAM
1 WIFE @IABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123@
0 TRLR
#model Bea /Example/

### G7-XREF-INVALID | L | xrefs valid in 5.5.1 only (`#`, lower case) inside a 7.0 file: read, written valid for 7.0
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I#1@ INDI
1 NAME Ann /Example/
1 FAMS @f1@
0 @f1@ FAM
1 WIFE @I#1@
0 TRLR
#model Ann /Example/

### G7-CONT-ORPHAN | L | CONT directly under a record that has no payload (python test_orphan_cont_rejected intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 CONT orphan text
1 SEX F
0 TRLR
#want 1 SEX F
#model orphan text

### G7-CONT-UNDER-PTR | L | CONT under a pointer payload (python test_cont_on_pointer_payload_rejected intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 FAMC @F1@
2 CONT stray text
0 @F1@ FAM
1 CHIL @I1@
0 TRLR
#want 1 FAMC @F1@
#model stray text

### G7-MALFORMED-LINES | L | a level alone and a text payload starting with a single `@` (python test_malformed_lines_rejected intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1
1 NOTE @invalid
1 SEX M
0 TRLR
#want 1 SEX M
#model @invalid

### G7-TRLR-DUP | L | duplicate TRLR and a record after it (Armidale "Duplicate TRLR record" intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 SEX F
0 TRLR
0 @I2@ INDI
1 SEX M
0 TRLR
#want 1 SEX F

### G7-PTR-WRONG-TYPE | L | pointer to a record of the wrong type (Armidale "SUBM points to a INDI record", python test_pointer_at_the_wrong_record_type intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 SUBM @I2@
0 @I2@ INDI
1 SEX M
0 TRLR
#model @I2@

### G7-NAME-INVALID | L | NAME payloads outside the personal-name grammar (Armidale invalid name intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NAME a/b/c/d
1 NAME /
0 TRLR
#model a/b/c/d

### G7-COORD-INVALID | L | malformed coordinates (gedcom-go malformed/coordinates intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 BIRT
2 PLAC Sampleton
3 MAP
4 LATI 91.5N
4 LONG W200
0 TRLR
#model 91.5N
#model W200

### G7-TIME-INVALID | L | times outside the grammar (Armidale invalid time intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 CHAN
2 DATE 1 JAN 2000
3 TIME 24:00:00
1 CREA
2 DATE 2 JAN 2000
3 TIME 2:5
0 TRLR
#model 24:00:00
#model 2:5

### G7-LONG-URL | C | a 7.0 payload over 255 characters is written whole, never CONC-split (FamilySearch long-url intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NOTE https://example.com/a/very/long/path/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/end
0 TRLR
#want 1 NOTE https://example.com/a/very/long/path/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa/end
#lacks CONC

### G7-SCHMA-MALFORMED | L | SCHMA TAG without a URI, and a TAG outside SCHMA (python malformed_tag_definition / tag_outside_schema intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
1 SCHMA
2 TAG _BROKEN
1 TAG _LOOSE https://example.com/loose
0 @I1@ INDI
1 _BROKEN value one
1 _LOOSE value two
0 TRLR
#model value one
#model value two

### G7-REMARRIAGE | C | the same couple in two FAM records, events in order (FamilySearch remarriage intent)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NAME Ann /Example/
1 FAMS @F1@
1 FAMS @F2@
0 @I2@ INDI
1 NAME Bob /Sample/
1 FAMS @F1@
1 FAMS @F2@
0 @F1@ FAM
1 HUSB @I2@
1 WIFE @I1@
1 MARR
2 DATE 1 MAY 1950
1 DIV
2 DATE 1 JUN 1960
0 @F2@ FAM
1 HUSB @I2@
1 WIFE @I1@
1 MARR
2 DATE 1 JUL 1970
0 TRLR
#want 2 DATE 1 JUL 1970

### G71-READ-WRITE | C | a GEDCOM 7.1 file with 7.1-only structures (HEAD.TITL, NOTE.KIND, BIRT.KIND, RESN on records) is written back as conformant 7.1
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.1
1 TITL Example family file
0 @I1@ INDI
1 BIRT
2 KIND BORN_LIVE
1 NOTE Kept for the record
2 KIND RESEARCH
0 @S1@ SOUR
1 RESN PRIVACY
1 TITL Example source
0 TRLR
#want 2 VERS 7.1
#want 2 KIND BORN_LIVE
#want 2 KIND RESEARCH
#want 1 RESN PRIVACY

### G71-WRITE-TARGET | C | a 7.0 file written with GEDCOM 7.1 as the target is conformant 7.1
#target 7.1
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NAME Ann /Example/
1 BIRT
2 DATE 1 JAN 1900
0 TRLR
#want 2 VERS 7.1
#want 2 DATE 1 JAN 1900
